interview.title: Discovery conversation
interview.hint: What the client actually said. Every artifact in this project is derived from these answers.

generate.requirementsHint: Turn this interview into a formal document: functional & non-functional requirements, user roles, business rules, constraints, and assumptions.
generate.systemHint: Turn the requirements into an architecture: the pattern (monolith / microservices), a tech stack, and the service modules.
generate.databaseHint: Derive the schema — entities, columns, primary/foreign keys, and relationships — from the services and roles.
generate.apiHint: Generate the REST API — endpoints grouped by module, with request/response schemas and status codes — from the entities and services.
generate.reviewHint: Run the AI architecture review: a scalability score, security & performance findings, missing features, and recommendations.

upgrade.title: Unlock the API design with Pro
upgrade.desc: Your Free plan covers the requirements, system design, and database design. Upgrade to Pro to generate the REST API — plus the AI review, roadmap, and export that follow.

actions.confirmBody: This replaces the current content — including any manual edits — with a freshly generated version.

wizard.cutline: API design and everything after it need Pro.
